mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ConsumptionRecordDEMS(StudentId, StaffId, Amount) VALUES(#{studentId}, #{staffId}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT cr.*, s.StudentName, st.StaffName FROM ConsumptionRecordDEMS cr LEFT JOIN StudentDEMS s ON cr.StudentId = s.StudentId LEFT JOIN StaffDEMS st ON cr.StaffId = st.StaffId WHERE cr.StudentId = #{studentId} ORDER BY cr.CreateTime DESC

SELECT cr.*, s.StudentName, st.StaffName FROM ConsumptionRecordDEMS cr LEFT JOIN StudentDEMS s ON cr.StudentId = s.StudentId LEFT JOIN StaffDEMS st ON cr.StaffId = st.StaffId WHERE cr.StaffId = #{staffId} AND DATE(cr.CreateTime) = #{date} ORDER BY cr.CreateTime DESC
